newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF group had double digit Q1 sales growth.
newsitem.headline: BASF group had double digit Q1 sales growth.

text.p: German chemicals company BASF showed double-digit sales growth in the first quarter, chairman Juergen Strube said on Wednesday.
For the full year, the company expects profits to grow at least as fast as sales.

Asked to elaborate on his descriptions of 1996 performance as a "peak year" and the 1997 outlook as a "special year", Strube told the annual news conference the terminology showed the company had not yet reached its limits.
Strube said margins had been squeezed in some business sectors in the first quarter, but that overall profit had improved.
Especially strong profit growth was seen in the health care and nutrition division, as well as in plastics and dyes.
The outlook for the oil and gas business was good, even if prices fell over the course of the year, he said.
Strube added he was less optimistic for the chemicals business, but the first three months of 1997 were satisfactory.
